Planner: Efficient stint, any word from the ramp coordinator on the next pet load and kennel checks?
Coordinator: Load flow is steady, and the welcome team is keeping transfers calm at the gate.
Planner: <<FACT F032>> Keep the pet cabin notes tight and flag any mismatch before we accept boarding.
Coordinator: Understood, and I will push a clean handoff to the desk with no loose paperwork.
Planner: Good. We also need the manifest cross-checked against carrier tags and cabin labels.
Coordinator: That is in progress, and the ramp side says the crates are secure and easy to trace.
Planner: <<FACT F051>> Watch the hold area for any last-minute change and keep pet owners brief and steady.
Coordinator: I have the channel open, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk will stay ready for the next wave.
Planner: Fine. If Elena Williams or Sofia Alvarez call in, route them straight through and keep Milolet calm.
Coordinator: Will do, and I will keep the line clear for boarding updates and pet support.
Planner: Good work. Stay sharp and keep the handoff clean.
